# Shader preparation recipes

The Ocarina of Time recipe was published with [Fritchii v5](https://github.com/Frizti/Fritchii/releases/tag/fritchii-v5).
It matches title `0400486024DEC000`, update revision `131072`, and Vulkan cache
format `54`. Jinra uses the recipe and the player's own game to assemble the
local shader preparation.
